headline: Disney appoints Character.AI's former chief executive as its first CTO
summary: Both reports say Disney has appointed Character.AI's former chief executive as its first-ever chief technology officer. One names him as Karandeep Anand; the other notes that Disney had previously sent Character.AI a cease-and-desist letter over its characters. The two texts do not conflict.
